name: Kyana Packaging Solutions
old_description: Kyana Packaging Solutions was founded in 1976 as Kyana Industrial Supply by Dave and Inez White in their home. Dave White believed that he could bring greater value to his customers than was available in the market, so he left his job to start Kyana Industrial Supply (known today as Kyana Packaging Solutions).
about:
Kyana Packaging Solutions traces its roots to 1976, when Dave and Inez White launched Kyana Industrial Supply from their home in Louisville, Kentucky. Dave White left his previous job convinced he could deliver greater value to customers than the market offered, and the couple built the business around that principle. Now operating as Kyana Packaging Solutions, the company remains headquartered in Louisville.

The company operates across three divisions. Kyana Packaging Solutions distributes a broad line of packaging supplies — corrugated boxes, tapes, poly bags, stretch and shrink films, cushioning, cold-chain materials, labels, strapping, safety and janitorial products — and sells packaging equipment. ASR Solutions provides third-party logistics, kitting, and assembly services, turning components into ready-to-ship kits. Bethlehem Die Cutting produces custom die-cut parts for specialized packaging and industrial applications. The firm also offers a packaging assessment program to help clients optimize their packaging spend and performance.

Kyana serves manufacturers, e-commerce fulfillment centers, warehouses, and logistics operations that need reliable packaging materials and value-added services. Its logistics division handles warehousing and distribution for clients across the Midwest, while the die-cutting unit supports custom protective packaging for fragile or irregularly shaped goods.

The business was founded on the idea that a supplier could do more than drop off boxes — it could help customers solve packaging challenges, reduce waste, and lower total cost. That service-first mindset still drives the company’s expansion into logistics, kitting, and custom fabrication.
